(ottoq.site_power_excursion,system_event,"The site's TOTAL metered grid import exceeded its declared cap (utility service contract, or a tighter active demand-response call). Not raised by any rule: EN.001.grid_capacity_ceiling names service_max_kw but meters EV charging only, so a total of 2,738.8 kW against a 2,500 kW contract -- EV 1,691.8 under its own nameplate plus BESS charging at 968 plus 79 base -- passed every check the engine has. Payload names the dominant component, because the cheap remedy is usually to defer the battery rather than refuse a vehicle.",,ottoq.ottoq_detect_site_power_excursion,critical,0374,f,"2026-09-20 12:32:13.321363+00")
